# legendry

The goal of legendry is to provide additional guide functionality to the
ggplot2 ecosystem.

## Installation

You can install the development version of legendry from
[GitHub](https://github.com/) with:

``` r

# install.packages("devtools")
devtools::install_github("teunbrand/legendry")
```

## Example

Let’s first set up a basic plot to experiment with:

``` r

library(legendry)
#> Loading required package: ggplot2

base <- ggplot(mpg, aes(displ, hwy, colour = cty)) +
  geom_point() +
  labs(
    x = "Engine displacement",
    y = "Highway miles per gallon",
    col = "City miles\nper gallon"
  ) +
  theme(axis.line = element_line())
```

The legendry package offers a selection of what it calls ‘complete
guides’. These complete guides can just be drop-in replacement of
regular guides, which you can specify using ggplot2’s
[`guides()`](https://ggplot2.tidyverse.org/reference/guides.html)
function or using the `guide` argument in scales. In the example below,
we’re using two custom variants of vanilla guides, namely
[`guide_axis_base()`](https://teunbrand.github.io/legendry/reference/guide_axis_base.md)
and
[`guide_colbar()`](https://teunbrand.github.io/legendry/reference/guide_colbar.md).
These custom variants have additional options that allow a greater
degree of customisation:

- The axis guide has an option for bidirectional ticks.
- The colourbar automatically recognises out-of-bounds values and
  displays this with a cap.

``` r

base + 
  scale_colour_viridis_c(
    limits = c(NA, 30),
    guide = "colbar"
  ) +
  guides(
    x = guide_axis_base(bidi = TRUE)
  )
```

![](reference/figures/README-full_guides-1.svg)

Besides complete guides, legendry also has incomplete guides that can be
composed. The
[`ggplot2::guide_axis_stack()`](https://ggplot2.tidyverse.org/reference/guide_axis_stack.html)
is an axis composition function that can be used to display multiple
guides. Here, we use a ‘primitive’ guide (incomplete building block) to
display a range on the axis. By stacking it with a regular axis the
primitive guide is completed.

``` r

# A partial guide to display a bracket
efficient_bracket <- primitive_bracket(
  # Keys determine what is displayed
  key = key_range_manual(start = 25, end = Inf, name = "Efficient"),
  bracket = "square",
  # We want vertical text
  theme = theme(
    legend.text = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 0.5),
    axis.text.y.left = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 0.5)
  )
)

base + guides(y = guide_axis_stack("axis", efficient_bracket))
```

![](reference/figures/README-primitives-1.svg)

The legendry package extends this guide composition concept beyond the
axes for other types of guides. In the example below we compose a
‘sandwich’: a central guide flanked by two others. Because our bracket
is a primitive, it does not matter what aesthetic it displays and we can
re-use it for the sandwich. I’ve yet to write the vignette on
composition.

``` r

base + 
  scale_colour_viridis_c(
    guide = compose_sandwich(
      middle = gizmo_density(), 
      text = "axis_base",
      opposite = efficient_bracket
    )
  )
```

![](reference/figures/README-composition-1.svg)

## Code of Conduct

Please note that the legendry project is released with a [Contributor
Code of
Conduct](https://teunbrand.github.io/legendry/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.html). By
contributing to this project, you agree to abide by its terms.

# Package index

## Guides to go

These guides are complete and ready to use in your plots.

- [`guide_axis_base()`](https://teunbrand.github.io/legendry/reference/guide_axis_base.md)
  : Custom axis guide
- [`guide_axis_dendro()`](https://teunbrand.github.io/legendry/reference/guide_axis_dendro.md)
  : Dendrogram guide
- [`guide_axis_nested()`](https://teunbrand.github.io/legendry/reference/guide_axis_nested.md)
  : Nested axis guide
- [`guide_axis_plot()`](https://teunbrand.github.io/legendry/reference/guide_axis_plot.md)
  **\[experimental\]** : Side-plot axis
- [`guide_axis_symbols()`](https://teunbrand.github.io/legendry/reference/guide_axis_symbols.md)
  [`guide_axis_upset()`](https://teunbrand.github.io/legendry/reference/guide_axis_symbols.md)
  **\[experimental\]** : Symbol and upset axis guide
- [`guide_circles()`](https://teunbrand.github.io/legendry/reference/guide_circles.md)
  : Circle size guide
- [`guide_colbar()`](https://teunbrand.github.io/legendry/reference/guide_colbar.md)
  : Custom colour bar guide
- [`guide_colring()`](https://teunbrand.github.io/legendry/reference/guide_colring.md)
  : Colour rings and arcs
- [`guide_colsteps()`](https://teunbrand.github.io/legendry/reference/guide_colsteps.md)
  : Custom colour steps guide
- [`guide_legend_base()`](https://teunbrand.github.io/legendry/reference/guide_legend_base.md)
  : Custom legend guide
- [`guide_legend_cross()`](https://teunbrand.github.io/legendry/reference/guide_legend_cross.md)
  : Cross legend guide
- [`guide_legend_group()`](https://teunbrand.github.io/legendry/reference/guide_legend_group.md)
  : Grouped legend
- [`guide_legend_manual()`](https://teunbrand.github.io/legendry/reference/guide_legend_manual.md)
  **\[experimental\]** : Manual legend

## Primitives

These are incomplete guides used in composition.

- [`guide-primitives`](https://teunbrand.github.io/legendry/reference/guide-primitives.md)
  : Guide primitives
- [`primitive_box()`](https://teunbrand.github.io/legendry/reference/primitive_box.md)
  : Guide primitives: boxes
- [`primitive_bracket()`](https://teunbrand.github.io/legendry/reference/primitive_bracket.md)
  : Guide primitive: brackets
- [`primitive_fence()`](https://teunbrand.github.io/legendry/reference/primitive_fence.md)
  : Guide primitive: fence
- [`primitive_labels()`](https://teunbrand.github.io/legendry/reference/primitive_labels.md)
  : Guide primitive: labels
- [`primitive_line()`](https://teunbrand.github.io/legendry/reference/primitive_line.md)
  : Guide primitive: line
- [`primitive_segments()`](https://teunbrand.github.io/legendry/reference/primitive_segments.md)
  : Guide primitives: segments
- [`primitive_spacer()`](https://teunbrand.github.io/legendry/reference/primitive_spacer.md)
  : Guide primitive: spacer
- [`primitive_ticks()`](https://teunbrand.github.io/legendry/reference/primitive_ticks.md)
  : Guide primitive: line
- [`primitive_title()`](https://teunbrand.github.io/legendry/reference/primitive_title.md)
  : Guide primitive: title

## Gizmos

These are specialty gimmicks tailored to displaying specific aesthetics.

- [`guide-gizmos`](https://teunbrand.github.io/legendry/reference/guide-gizmos.md)
  : Guide gizmos
- [`gizmo_barcap()`](https://teunbrand.github.io/legendry/reference/gizmo_barcap.md)
  : Guide gizmo: capped colour bar
- [`gizmo_density()`](https://teunbrand.github.io/legendry/reference/gizmo_density.md)
  : Guide gizmo: kernel density estimate
- [`gizmo_grob()`](https://teunbrand.github.io/legendry/reference/gizmo_grob.md)
  : Guide gizmo: custom grob
- [`gizmo_histogram()`](https://teunbrand.github.io/legendry/reference/gizmo_histogram.md)
  : Guide gizmo: histogram
- [`gizmo_stepcap()`](https://teunbrand.github.io/legendry/reference/gizmo_stepcap.md)
  : Guide gizmo: capped colour steps

## Composition

These are not guides, but ways to combine guides, primitives and gizmos
together to become a more complete guide.

- [`new_compose()`](https://teunbrand.github.io/legendry/reference/guide-composition.md)
  **\[experimental\]** : Guide composition
- [`compose_crux()`](https://teunbrand.github.io/legendry/reference/compose_crux.md)
  **\[experimental\]** : Compose guides in a cross
- [`compose_ontop()`](https://teunbrand.github.io/legendry/reference/compose_ontop.md)
  **\[experimental\]** : Compose guides on top of one another
- [`compose_sandwich()`](https://teunbrand.github.io/legendry/reference/compose_sandwich.md)
  **\[experimental\]** : Compose guides as a sandwich
- [`compose_stack()`](https://teunbrand.github.io/legendry/reference/compose_stack.md)
  **\[experimental\]** : Compose guides as stack

Fantastic labels and where to display them.

- [`key_group_split()`](https://teunbrand.github.io/legendry/reference/key_group.md)

  : Group keys

  [`key_range_manual()`](https://teunbrand.github.io/legendry/reference/key_range.md)
  [`key_range_map()`](https://teunbrand.github.io/legendry/reference/key_range.md)
  : Range keys
- [`key_segment_manual()`](https://teunbrand.github.io/legendry/reference/key_segments.md)
  [`key_segment_map()`](https://teunbrand.github.io/legendry/reference/key_segments.md)
  [`key_dendro()`](https://teunbrand.github.io/legendry/reference/key_segments.md)
  : Segment keys
- [`key_sequence()`](https://teunbrand.github.io/legendry/reference/key_specialty.md)
  [`key_bins()`](https://teunbrand.github.io/legendry/reference/key_specialty.md)
  [`key_upset()`](https://teunbrand.github.io/legendry/reference/key_specialty.md)
  [`key_symbols()`](https://teunbrand.github.io/legendry/reference/key_specialty.md)
  : Speciality keys
- [`key_auto()`](https://teunbrand.github.io/legendry/reference/key_standard.md)
  [`key_manual()`](https://teunbrand.github.io/legendry/reference/key_standard.md)
  [`key_map()`](https://teunbrand.github.io/legendry/reference/key_standard.md)
  [`key_minor()`](https://teunbrand.github.io/legendry/reference/key_standard.md)
  [`key_log()`](https://teunbrand.github.io/legendry/reference/key_standard.md)
  [`key_none()`](https://teunbrand.github.io/legendry/reference/key_standard.md)
  : Standard keys

Miscellaneous functions not directly concerned with guides

- [`cap_triangle()`](https://teunbrand.github.io/legendry/reference/cap_options.md)
  [`cap_round()`](https://teunbrand.github.io/legendry/reference/cap_options.md)
  [`cap_arch()`](https://teunbrand.github.io/legendry/reference/cap_options.md)
  [`cap_ogee()`](https://teunbrand.github.io/legendry/reference/cap_options.md)
  [`cap_none()`](https://teunbrand.github.io/legendry/reference/cap_options.md)

- [`theme_guide()`](https://teunbrand.github.io/legendry/reference/theme_guide.md)
  : Theme wrapper for guides
- [`scale_x_dendro()`](https://teunbrand.github.io/legendry/reference/scale_x_dendro.md)

  : Helper to position text
